name: QQ Mail
description: Search, read, and organize QQ Mail via IMAP/SMTP, and create drafts or send messages. The authorization code is stored securely by Cindy and only provided to the plugin Worker transiently when executing a mailbox request.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to find, read, or organize QQ Mail messages, and to create drafts or send email. Before first use, enter the QQ Mail address and IMAP/SMTP authorization code on the plugin details page and complete the connection test.

qq_mail_status.description: Check whether QQ Mail is configured. Returns only the mail address and connection status, never the authorization code.

qq_mail.description: Run a QQ Mail operation: list folders, search, read, send, save a draft, mark read/unread, or move messages. Each operation opens a transient IMAP/SMTP connection and closes it when done; sending, moving, and changing read status must come from an explicit user request.
